papers.title: On torsional behavior of 3D printed 17-4 PH-SS-Ni-625-Ti-6Al-4V compositionally graded structures with lattice interlayers for biomedical applications
papers.abstract: Powder bed fusion–laser beam (PBF-LB) has emerged as a highly adaptable 3D printing technique for fabricating compositionally graded, multi-material structures with tunable mechanical properties. However, limited studies have been reported on the torsional behavior of such graded structures (fabricated by 3D printing), especially those incorporating lattice interlayers for biomedical load-bearing applications. In this study, compositionally graded specimens were fabricated using PBF-LB, consisting of a 17-4 PH stainless steel (SS) base layer, a Ni-625 intermediate layer, and a Ti-6Al-4V top layer. To improve mechanical performance (under torsion), different interlayer architectures, solid, octet-truss, and Weaire Phelan lattices were introduced within the graded structure. The fabricated samples were characterized using SEM/EDS, porosity, and grain-size analysis. In addition, Thermo-Calc simulations were performed to examine phase stability at multi-material interfaces. Among the topologies, the Weaire-Phelan lattice-based graded structure demonstrated a torsional resistance of 9.7 Nm, comparable to the torque typically required for pedicle screw insertion in lumbar spine applications. The study suggests that incorporating architected lattice interlayers can effectively balance strength and compliance, making these 3D-printed graded structures a viable solution for advanced biomedical applications.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文涉及Ti-6Al-4V仅作为多层梯度结构的一部分，未专门研究其力学或疲劳性能。
llm.why_not_core: The paper is not exclusively about Ti-6Al-4V; it studies compositionally graded multi-material structures, and the mechanical testing is torsion, not fatigue or tensile of Ti-6Al-4V alone.

summary_zh.motivation: 探索3D打印梯度结构含晶格夹层的扭转性能，以用于生物医学承载。
summary_zh.method: 用PBF-LB制备17-4 PH SS、Ni-625、Ti-6Al-4V梯度样品，并嵌入不同晶格夹层。
summary_zh.result: Weaire-Phelan晶格结构扭转抗力达9.7 Nm，接近腰椎椎弓根螺钉插入扭矩。
summary_zh.validation: 通过SEM/EDS、孔隙率、晶粒分析和扭转实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the torsional behavior of 3D printed compositionally graded structures with lattice interlayers for biomedical load-bearing applications.
summary_en.method: Graded specimens comprising 17-4 PH SS, Ni-625, and Ti-6Al-4V were fabricated via PBF-LB, incorporating solid, octet-truss, or Weaire-Phelan lattice interlayers.
summary_en.result: The Weaire-Phelan lattice graded structure achieved a torsional resistance of 9.7 Nm, comparable to the torque for pedicle screw insertion in lumbar spine.
summary_en.validation: Validation included SEM/EDS, porosity, grain-size analysis, and torsion testing.

papers.title: Mechanism-informed prediction of fretting fatigue crack initiation in Ti-6Al-4V dovetail joints strengthened by shot and laser shock peening under coupled high-low cycle loading

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文直接研究喷丸和激光冲击强化对Ti-6Al-4V燕尾接头微动疲劳行为的影响，属于后处理调控疲劳性能的核心方向。
llm.why_not_core: It focuses solely on peening-based post-processing and does not cover other L2 treatments such as heat treatment, HIP, machining, or coatings.

summary_zh.motivation: 针对喷丸与激光冲击强化钛合金燕尾接头的微动疲劳裂纹萌生进行预测建模。
summary_zh.method: 基于机理的预测方法，耦合高-低循环载荷并考虑喷丸与激光冲击引入的残余应力。
summary_zh.result: 实现了对强化后接头疲劳裂纹萌生位置的定量预测。
summary_zh.validation: 通过典型燕尾接头工况的数值模拟进行验证。

summary_en.motivation: To predict fretting fatigue crack initiation in Ti-6Al-4V dovetail joints strengthened by shot and laser shock peening under coupled high-low cycle loading.
summary_en.method: A mechanism-informed modeling approach that incorporates residual stress fields induced by peening into a fretting fatigue crack initiation criterion.
summary_en.result: The model provides quantitative predictions of crack initiation location and life for peened dovetail joint configurations.
summary_en.validation: The prediction framework is demonstrated through numerical simulation of a representative dovetail joint case.
